notes.title: My new game - FRISIA
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I have an exciting  announcement. Since about a year I am working on an new game called FRISIA. In comparison to Jotunn, FRISIA is a much more calm an relaxing experience.

To be more precise, FRISIA is an atmospheric village builder in which you are tasked with setting up a picturesque town on an uninhabited north sea island. Use the tides, that influence the landscape to your advantage, collect resources, set out on expeditions with your ship and watch your village flourish!

The demo has been out for a while now, but I just released a new update, which is why I chose to share the news here. I have learned a lot from the development of Jotunn - Day of Judgement, which helped me a great deal on my journey for FRISIA. 

So feel free to check out the demo (it's also free) and of course let me know what you think over in the FRISIA forums!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578430/Frisia__Cozy_Villages/]Check out FRISIA and leave a wishlist![/url]
